title: SYNTHETIC: a duplicated record that no declared check looks for must be reported as a BLIND_SPOT by mutation testing
scientific_question: Illustrative only (the setting is fictional): do the invented lantern readings of the fictional Brassmoor stations agree with the declared values? No real station, instrument, person or measurement is described.
claim_tested: When `science-gate mutate` runs on an accepting evidence tree whose declared checks (required_columns, numeric_agreement) include no duplicate_rows check and no independent row count, the mutation operator M04_duplicate_row is applicable and executed. Its mutant, with record BM-04 duplicated and the digest re-declared, still verifies as PASS, so the report marks M04_duplicate_row as escaped (blind_spot true). The overall status is FAIL with reason BLIND_SPOT and exit code 1. Every other executed operator is detected by its expected detector, and the sensitivity figure is reported as 9/10 (21 operators, ARCHITECTURE.md 17.12; 8/9 under the 20 operators of 0.1.0 until 2026-10-28) rather than rounded up or hidden.
falsified_by: Running `science-gate mutate manifest.json` from this entry directory yields any status other than FAIL, any exit code other than 1, a reason other than BLIND_SPOT, a blind-spot set other than exactly [M04_duplicate_row], an M04 mutant that is not reported as verifying PASS, or a mutation-report.md that does not name M04_duplicate_row and its expected detector check:duplicate_rows.

unresolved_cases: In a first draft of this fixture the numeric_agreement check cited BM-04, the record M04 duplicates. The mutant then ABSTAINed (REQUIRES_HUMAN_REVIEW, ambiguous key), and M04 was still reported as a blind spot because its expected detector did not fire. That 'caught for the wrong reason' variant is a distinct property and deserves its own entry. It is not covered here.

The expected counts (9 applicable and executed, 8 detected, 1 escaped, 11 not applicable) depend on the 20 operators of science-gate 0.1.0. A tool with a different operator set would need its own expected counts, but the blind-spot set must still be exactly [M04_duplicate_row].
science-gate mutate writes no receipt. The receipt in receipts/ comes from a supplementary `verify` of the same manifest, which is the accepting baseline (PASS).

2026-10-28 fixture repair: the row_count check 'rows' was removed from manifest.json. Under ARCHITECTURE.md 17.5 a row_count PASS needs a falsifier witness, and its only case (drop-last-row) needs an INDEPENDENT expected_rows; this input deliberately has none (an independent count would also expose M04 through closure), so the check could only ABSTAIN / BLIND_SPOT (FALSIFIER_NO_CASE) and the accepting baseline was invalid (INVALID_BASELINE). Without it the baseline verifies as PASS with witnessed required_columns and numeric_agreement checks.
